Contract bundles gq / gr [529:0] have NO body port (the SU face ends here directly): drop from the slot?
structural_change: sl2: outline 172.8 x 216 instead of the 388.776^2 slot (first gate there: util 7 %, 16,646 sinks on one root at TT insertion 467.8 ps > 300 = refused by the clock rule): every flop within ~110 um of its face, tree depth set by the cell not the slot; every port on its own range, placed pin by pin (W 1,639 pins on 184 um, E 1,099, S 1,043, N 298).

job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v4b slot cell qkd_embgw (1 instance, 388.776^2): the merged-die embedding gateway (HBM-held embedding table read through the four landing strips), wiring-only slot cell around ot_qkvd_embgw_m. 6,413 flops + 10,240 buffer bits (4 link FIFOs of 4 x 520 b, boot skid, request queue) = ~16.7 k sinks on one root: the --cts gate measures insertion / spread (clock rule, measured form).
